All lengths are in bits, in ACVP's own TOP-ALIGNED convention (the same one the repository's SHA-3/SHAKE ACVP consumers already adapt): a trailing partial input byte holds its valid bits in the HIGH positions, so shift it down by 8 - (bits mod 8) to get the FIPS 202 h2b byte the sponge absorbs; an output of a non-multiple-of-8 bit length is ceil(bits/8) bytes whose last byte carries the final bits in its HIGH positions, so shift the sponge's low-aligned last byte up by the same amount before comparing. Customization and function-name strings are hex of their ASCII bytes. Generated by tools/classical-vectors-gen/acvp_sp800185_to_json.py.
